title: MxAgile Process State
description: Per-wave durable lifecycle state. CANONICAL FILE: planning/lifecycle/process-state.yaml (Git-tracked). `.concord/scratch/process-state.yaml` is an optional local working cache — it is NOT the authoritative source. Agents MUST read and write the canonical file in planning/lifecycle/. The local cache may be used for session-local convenience but deleting it must not destroy canonical lifecycle knowledge. CANONICAL UPDATE RULE: always write the COMPLETE wave block — never append individual keys into an existing block. Appending creates duplicate YAML keys. See .mxagile/policies/lifecycle-resync.md.

waves.description: Keyed by wave ID (e.g. W01, W02). Each wave block must be written atomically.

wave.description: State for one wave. phase MUST appear exactly once — write the full block, never append.

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase. Defined in .mxagile/lifecycle.yaml. One occurrence per wave block.

paused_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the wave was paused

completed_scripts.description: MDL scripts executed and done in this wave

next_script.description: Next MDL script to execute on resume (supplementary — checklist is authoritative)

prerequisite_state.description: Non-secret readiness state for development prerequisites. NEVER store credential values here — only readiness classifications. Use this to resume after user provides required secret input without restarting from zero.

runtime_config.description: Credential/config discovery status. discovered=source found but not all keys present; incomplete=source missing; user_input_required=bootstrap prepared, awaiting developer input; configured=all keys present; ready=validated successfully.

runtime_pipeline_stage.description: Current or last-achieved local runtime startup stage. See policies/local-runtime-profile.md — Runtime Pipeline State Model. build_succeeded MUST NOT be treated as application_reachable. Agents must not start Playwright until browser_rendered; must not execute role scenarios until authenticated_session_ready.

database.description: Database connectivity status after using configured credentials.

mock_data.description: Representative mock/seed data readiness for UI-driven scenarios.

test_identities.description: Test user/role identity readiness for browser verification.

discovery_evidence_level.description: Highest evidence level achieved during Discovery phase. Determines whether Full UI Discovery PASS is valid.

blocked_operation.description: Non-secret description of the operation that was blocked, for auto-resume. e.g. 'UI Discovery browser comparison for page Customer_NewEdit'

observe_before_mutate_stage.description: Current stage in the Observe-Before-Mutate lifecycle. See policies/observe-before-mutate.md. violation_detected=agent performed mutation before completing observation; requires manual resolution.

mutation_eligibility.description: Whether implementation mutation (SCSS, widget, content changes) is currently allowed. blocked=Refinement gate not yet passed. allowed=Refinement accepted, mutation may proceed. violation_detected=mutation was attempted before eligibility was established; requires developer resolution. See policies/observe-before-mutate.md.

coverage_matrix_state.description: Non-secret coverage matrix progress. Tracks which material scenarios are required, completed, and which acceptance clauses remain unverified.

scenarios_required.description: Total number of required material scenarios for this wave.

scenarios_completed.description: Number of required scenarios with status=completed and parity_result=PASS.

uncovered_clauses.description: Acceptance clause identifiers not yet covered by any completed scenario.

stale_scenarios.description: SCN-... IDs that were PASS but have become STALE due to target/requirement changes.

parity_reconciliation.description: Non-secret progress of multi-dimensional parity reconciliation. For resumable evidence upgrade across sessions. See policies/ui-parity.md.

mode.description: lazy=only verify dimensions with NOT_VERIFIED or LEGACY_EVIDENCE status. full=re-verify all dimensions for all pages.

pages_total.description: Total number of pages to reconcile.

pages_completed.description: Pages for which all required dimensions have been verified.

pages_remaining.description: Non-secret page IDs not yet reconciled.

schema_upgraded.description: True when all parity records have been structurally migrated to the dimensional schema.

overall_result.description: Aggregated reconciliation status across all pages.

resume_from.description: Supplementary free-text hint. Structured checklist state (done/pending/failed) is authoritative for resume position.

result.description: not_recorded is only valid before the gate has been run for this wave.

evidence.description: Key-value evidence supporting the gate result. Any structure allowed.
